source.note: Bureau's own internships-and-fellowships page. Pathways is a government-wide hiring authority; this record transcribes only what the Census Bureau itself publishes about it.

apply.note: Bureau's own internships page; federal postings are made through USAJOBS.

class_year.quote: The Pathways Internship Program provides paid work experience to high school, undergraduate, or graduate students in an accredited college or university program.

cooling_off.notes: The page carries no sentence addressing reapplication, waiting periods, or a cap on applications. Searched the fetched markup for 'reappl', 're-appl' and 'apply again': no match.

unfiled_quotes.quote: The Economic Measurement and Research Internship (EMRI) Program seeks to hire interns in economics, accounting, and related fields to support the nation’s growing demand for information.
The Pathways Recent Graduate Program allows recent graduates to enter the Federal service and provides long-term, on the job professional training and development.

provenance.note: compensation is silent even though the class-year quote contains the words 'paid work experience': that wording is part of the eligibility sentence and is not a separate statement about pay, so it is not duplicated into the compensation field. Sponsorship is silent: the page contains no occurrence of citizen, visa, CPT, OPT, sponsor or work authorisation. That silence is worth noting rather than assuming, because the Federal Reserve Board states a flat citizenship bar and the Atlanta Fed states a CPT position, while this body publishes neither. Silent here means only that nothing is published on the point.
